title: Invariance of the Fourier one-norm
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and a set $U$ of coordinates, the Fourier one-norm of the pointwise product of $f$ with the monomial indexed by $U$ equals the Fourier one-norm of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$U$ is a finite set of coordinates
